channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rudy Gobert | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rudy Gobert from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jon Krawczynski on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski on the status of Rudy Gobert's contract extensión:

“He is eligible for an extension. So far, I have not heard any sort of real momentum toward that happening immediately here. I think it is something that the team will explore, that maybe Rudy would look at as well, as he gets a little, you know, as he gets older. We saw his last extension, he brought his number down a little bit more to make it more manageable to have a good team around him. I would imagine that if there was something to be done, it would be another scenario like that where his number, I think is at 31 or 33 million now, maybe comes down annually, but he gets a little bit more long-term security with a multi-year extension.”

Jon Krawczynski on Rudy Gobert, Sep 24, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Ryan Smith on Rudy Gobert, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Jazz owner Ryan Smith:

“I don't want to set expectations, but like we need to start winning. I think that's that's that's kind of where we're at. When we took over, I took over what was the number one team in the regular season and we got, I mean, it was interesting. My first day was like post-COVID. We were kind of into COVID and I had like two weeks to get a deal done with Rudy Gobert and Donovan Mitchell. It was really complicated because normally you have a long time to do this, but that team came out, we were number one in the regular season the first year and just got bounced early.”

Ryan Smith on Rudy Gobert, Donovan Mitchell, Jun 25, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Chris Finch on Julius Randle, Rudy Gobert, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Chris Finch:

“I felt that going into Game 6, we tried to make some adjustments that were clearly not right. I kicked myself for doing it, just because I felt we didn't probably need to be as extreme. I flipped the matchups around. We put Rudy Gobert on Castle, and we started with Julius Randle on Victor Wembanyama, trying to mitigate Wembanyama's hot starts. We did a good job, but then Castle got loose on us. It wasn't a scheme that we were overly comfortable with. We've done it from time to time, and it maybe just wouldn't have been the time to do it.”

Chris Finch on Julius Randle, Rudy Gobert, Victor Wembanyama, Jun 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Darren Wolfson on Anthony Edwards, Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Darren Wolfson on Wolves trading Rudy Gobert:

“Put it this way, the way it's been laid out to me, outside of Anthony Edwards, just about everything is legitimately on the table.”

Darren Wolfson on Anthony Edwards, Rudy Gobert, Jun 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Draymond Green, Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Dwyane Wade:

“Draymond Green walked up on me before and had a conversation. He didn't like what I said in the Olympics about something. It was about Rudy Gobert. It was about Rudy Gobert and I know we had to have that conversation and I had to express with him like, hold on, I got a job. I got a role. I'm on the government side of the Utah Jazz. I want Rudy Gobert to do. Yes, I want the US to win. But also I want to see Rudy Gobert had success. And we said there had that combo and I appreciated that because he came up to me about, hey, I didn't like how you said this and I was like, respect now, let's talk about it. So as long as it go that way and we could talk about how you received it.”

Dwyane Wade on Draymond Green, Rudy Gobert, May 20, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Victor Wembanyama on facing Rudy Gobert in the playoffs:

“It's great. We're already lucky to face him regularly during the regular season, and it's tough to play against him, it's demanding. He's played a huge role in my journey, has been a role model, has inspired me in so many ways that should actually inspire more people, especially when it comes to the care given to the body, which is an example for all big men.”

Victor Wembanyama on Rudy Gobert, May 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chris Finch on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Chris Finch on Rudy Gobert:

“I think he’s far and away the leader for defensive player of the year.”

Chris Finch on Rudy Gobert, Mar 7, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Heat coach Erik Spoelstra said.

“Rudy Gobert continues to be one of the more underrated players in this league. He knows who he is. He knows how he impacts the game.”

Erik Spoelstra on Rudy Gobert, Jan 7, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Kevon Looney on Julius Randle, Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Kevon Looney on the physicality vs Gobert:

“Last series I feel like was way worse than anything I did last game. It’s the playoffs. I’m gonna grab and push until they call it. Rudy’s a great rebounder. Randle…Everybody got their own little tricks they do.”

Kevon Looney on Julius Randle, Rudy Gobert, May 7, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
“We have one of them on our team in Zacch. Like I’ve said before, his competitiveness is unique, especially for his age. Rudy [Gobert] had that level of fight in him. Rudy was incredibly competitive. anybody that watches Rudy and Zacch play, they’re different players, but they’re very unique.”

Quin Snyder on Rudy Gobert, Mar 8, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Suns coach Mike Budenholzer on strategy with Rudy Gobert (back) out:

“Hopefully our guys are aggressive. If there's opportunities to get to the paint, finish. Opportunities on the offensive boards. If it's (Julius) Randle and (Naz) Reid or whoever their backup bigs are, make them have to move and guard the pick-and-roll. Just be aggressive, attacking, just generally speaking but also make an effort to get to the offensive boards some too.”

Mike Budenholzer on Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Rudy Gobert, Mar 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Ivica Zubac on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Ivica Zubac on Dream Shake vs Rudy Gobert:

“Not surprised by it… When I was younger, I played a lot in the post… I still worked on it, even if teams didn't use it. I was just waiting for my moment.”

Ivica Zubac on Rudy Gobert, Nov 30, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on Rudy Gobert's offense and dishing him the ball:

“Rudy been working. It’s a difference when you see people work. Like you start to trust them a little more. You make that pass. He been working, and we have no reason to not trust him.”

Anthony Edwards on Rudy Gobert, Nov 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Victor Wembanyama:

“There are active players I admire. As I said, some of the guys, you know, just kind of... you know, some of the guys I've been watching growing up, I'm not disappointed, but I'm like, like that's it? But some of them, talking like KD, you know? Of course, I get to know Rudy Gobert even more with the national team. I know their work ethic, I know how they view the game, and it's really inspiring, and I want to do the same as them.”

Victor Wembanyama on Rudy Gobert, Oct 16, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Ryan Smith on Rudy Gobert, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Ryan Smith was asked about how the Jazz came to lean into the youth movement this season, a key talking point from the team’s preseason media appearances.

“We made that decision when we traded Donovan [Mitchell] and Rudy [Gobert] and got those picks,”

Ryan Smith on Rudy Gobert, Donovan Mitchell, Oct 15, 2024. Source: KSL Sports.

item.title: Josh Smith on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Josh Smith:

“I feel like they’re making people not respect the award. Like, come on, who’s doing the votes, you know what I’m saying? No disrespect to Rudy Gobert, but he shouldn’t have won this year. Come on, man, you know what I’m saying? You only got half of (Wembanyama's) blocks, and it’s like, what are the criteria?”

Josh Smith on Rudy Gobert, Oct 2, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Alex Sarr on Anthony Davis, Rudy Gobert, Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
Sarr:

“I studied the whole league, really. I just see how different guys are. There are a lot of different great shot blockers. I’ve looked at AD(Anthony Davis), Jaren Jackson Jr. and Rudy Gobert clips. For me, it’s more a matter of instincts and knowing when to go for the ball and knowing when not to go.”

Alex Sarr on Anthony Davis, Rudy Gobert, Jaren Jackson Jr, Jul 16, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Rudy Gobert, Marcus Smart, Jaren Jackson Jr
item.description:
“A point guard (Marcus Smart) got it over me, a center (Rudy Gobert) got it over me, a power forward (Jaren Jackson Jr.) has gotten it over me,”

Bam Adebayo on Rudy Gobert, Marcus Smart, Jaren Jackson Jr, Jul 10, 2024. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Batum said, looking ahead to the Olympics.

“But when you have two greats [Wembanyama and Gobert], it helps a lot.”

Nicolas Batum on Rudy Gobert, Jul 4, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Rudy Gobert, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Mavericks' Jason Kidd on Luka Doncic's game-winner:

“We wanted to get him space and let him do what he does. He set [Rudy Gobert] up for the step-back. For him attacking the paint over and over, Rudy has to honor that. ... He loves that stage. He doesn't run from it.”

Jason Kidd on Rudy Gobert, Luka Doncic, May 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Luka Doncic on his game-winning shot over Defensive Player of the Year Rudy Gobert:

“He’s long. He can’t move. I can’t move fast, but I can move faster than him.”

Luka Doncic on Rudy Gobert, May 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Chris Finch on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Chris Finch on the Rudy Gobert fine:

“I’d like to see the itemized receipt. If it’s 75 for the gesture then it must be 10K for the towel and 5 for the heating pad?”

Chris Finch on Rudy Gobert, May 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Paul George on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Paul George on Rudy Gobert:

“I think he made the right decision. It's the birth of your first. I've been a part of a tough pregnancy with my wife, and going through that, I could only imagine my wife being there alone and having to deliver a baby alone.”

Paul George on Rudy Gobert, May 11, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mike Conley on Rudy Gobert, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
And Conley on how they will have to guard Nikola Jokic if there is no Gobert:

“By committee. We got to throw a lot of bodies at him. We got to show him a lot of different looks. Can’t just give him one read. He’s so smart, has the ability to pick you apart if you show him the same thing multiple times. It’ll be a lot of junk. A lot of different things we have to implement. Something we’ve done throughout the year on different teams. We’ll have to implement that tonight.”

Mike Conley on Rudy Gobert, Nikola Jokic, May 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Mike Conley on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Mike Conley on potentially playing without Rudy Gobert tonight:

“It definitely changes things. He’s a big focal point of what we do, especially defensively. Also, offensively as well. But we’re a deep team and we got a lot of guys ready to step in and play for us if that’s the case, and just try to get a win by any means.”

Mike Conley on Rudy Gobert, May 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Rudy Gobert, Tim Connelly
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on the Timberwolves:

“When Tim Connelly made that trade (for Rudy Gobert) everybody was laughing at him and what he was doing. But he made a great team. I think he deserves credit for doing that.”

Nikola Jokic on Rudy Gobert, Tim Connelly, May 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns on Rudy Gobert's impact:

“To just talk about defense, he does things that doesn't show up on the stat sheet. So thank god we're more in the statistical era where Synergy and stuff like that can help us understand the impact he makes on our team.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Rudy Gobert, Apr 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Rudy Gobert, Karl-Anthony Towns
item.description:
Kevin Durant on making Rudy Gobert and Karl-Anthony Towns work defensively:

“Rudy’s gotten extremely better at guarding perimeters, guarding posts, guarding the rim. So you can’t just throw ‘em in actions expecting them to just give in. I think we’ll be strategic with what we do”

Kevin Durant on Rudy Gobert, Karl-Anthony Towns, Apr 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Drew Hanlen on Rudy Gobert, Nikola Jokic, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Drew Hanlen:

“We just kind of laugh about it. He’s played Jokic two times in the last two years and he had 47 [points], 18 [rebounds] and five [assists on Jan. 28, 2023. On Jan. 16, 2024], he had 41 [points], 10 [assists] and seven [rebounds].I don’t know why you would duck somebody that you’re averaging 45, 13 and eight against. If you look at Joel versus other big guys, he’s just dominated them. He had 70 against Victor [Wembanyama]. You look at him versus Rudy Gobert. I don’t know his exact numbers, but he had around 51 [points], 12 [rebounds], and three [assists] on Dec. 20, 2023.”

Drew Hanlen on Rudy Gobert, Nikola Jokic, Victor Wembanyama, Apr 16, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Michael Malone on Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone:

“Rudy Gobert is going to be a Hall of Fame player one day. He's going to be regarded as one of the greatest defenders of his generation…nobody can guard Nikola 1-on-1.”

Michael Malone on Rudy Gobert, Apr 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.
